read.title: Black Friday Checklist
read.text:
Hi team,

Black Friday is only two days away, so here is our final checklist.

First, our 30% markdown on the Snail Repair Cream starts at midnight Pacific time. Let's make sure the deal badge shows correctly on the product page.

Second, we expect a surge in traffic, so we raised our daily ad budgets ahead of the event. Please check the campaigns every few hours and pause any keyword with an ACoS above 40%.

Finally, our toner is close to going out of stock. If inventory falls below 300 units, we will move ad spend to the cleanser instead.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.en: Write a short message to your team listing two or three things to check before Black Friday.
write.model:
Hi everyone,

Black Friday starts tomorrow. Let's make sure all coupons are live by 10 p.m. and that the deal prices are correct. We expect a surge in orders, so please check FBA stock levels twice a day. I raised our ad budgets ahead of the event.

Thanks,
Minsu
